title: Engine Manifest
description: Schema for the 'engine' block within an extensions.json entry (D5).

install.description: How to install the engine into its own virtual environment.

requirements.description: pip-compatible requirement specifiers, e.g. git+https://... or package==1.2

pip_packages.description: Additional packages to install with pip after requirements.

launch.description: How to start the engine process.

cmd.description: Command and arguments. {port} is substituted at launch time.

env.description: Additional environment variables passed to the engine process.

cwd.description: Working directory for the engine process.

port_arg.description: Flag passed to the engine to set its listen port, e.g. '--port'.

path.description: HTTP path of the health endpoint, e.g. '/health'.

openai_speech_path.description: Path that implements the OpenAI /v1/audio/speech interface.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema for engine-specific generation parameters.

gradio_iframe.description: When true, the engine UI is served as a Gradio iframe.

cancel.description: How to cancel a running generation.

mode.description: 'disconnect' drops the client connection; 'endpoint' POSTs to a cancel path.

path.description: Cancel endpoint path (only used when mode is 'endpoint').

keep_alive.description: Idle timeout in seconds after which the engine process is stopped.
